architecture: 576-64-16-64-576 dense autoencoder; 3 hidden layers, not a CNN
protocol: fixed roles OP028 train / OP031 calibration / OP033 normal test / OP022 OP023 OP026 event test; all cameras kept in same Run split
causal_flag: 2 consecutive above-threshold frames; reset after >5s gap, no recovery flags
limitations: Only one normal Run used for training and one for calibration; same-stage process matching not verified.
ROIs inherited from preceding exploratory review; this is not a blinded confirmatory study.
OP033 Cam0 view mismatch: scores shown as out-of-view comparison and excluded from normal comparison claims.
Event annotations are air-ingress interventions, not bubble onset labels.
A new flag before a sensor annotation is not validated early detection.
Frame windows and cameras are correlated; do not count frames as independent trials.
80 epochs is a fixed exploration budget; warning may report optimizer did not converge.
No raw sensor values or measured camera/sensor synchronization uncertainty supplied.
